lines.en: It happened a long time ago, when I was still a student at university.
Suddenly, we heard a strange noise coming from the kitchen.
While I was walking home, it started to rain heavily.
At first, nobody believed his story, but later it turned out to be true.
As soon as she opened the door, she knew that something was wrong.
We used to sit around my grandmother and listen to her amazing stories.
By the time we arrived, the show had already started.
In the end, everything worked out better than we had expected.
He told us that he had never been so frightened in his whole life.
And that is how I learned never to give up, no matter how hard things get.
